title: The influence of silicon and aluminum alloying on the lattice parameter and stacking fault energy of austenitic steel
abstract: The influence of Si and Al on the lattice parameter and stacking fault energy (SFE) of austenitic steel was studied. X-ray difraction indicated that 2.5 wt.% Al alloying increased the austenite lattice parameter by 1.41 - 10<sup>3</sup> nm, whereas 2.5 wt.% Si alloying had little efect. Partial dislocation separation measurements from weak-beam dark-field images indicated that 2.5 wt.% Al alloying increased the SFE by 12–17 mJ m<sup>2</sup> and 2.5 wt.% Si alloying decreased the SFE by 6–7 mJ m<sup>2</sup>. - 2014 Acta Materialia Inc.
